extensions.reviewer_isolation_recipe: Set sandbox_mode = "read-only" in the reviewer agent TOML to achieve structural write-deny. sandbox_mode = "workspace-write" is the writer default.
extensions.skill_tool_note: Codex discovers SKILL.md via `.agents/skills` (cross-tool open path) and `$HOME/.agents/skills`. Skill content preloads at session start; no runtime Skill() primitive callable from another skill.
